title: Equality of etale unit images reflects locally on X
statement: Let $X$ and $Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Write $b_i:X_{\Et}\to Z_{\Et}$ for base change, $i^*F$ for its sheaf inverse image with adjunction unit $\eta^{\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction], and $j_X,j_Z$ for the open-subscheme inclusion functors. Suppose $A$ and $G$ are topological sheaves of sets on $X$ and $Z$, with presheaf isomorphisms $e_X:A\cong F\circ j_X$ and $e_Z:G\cong (i^*F)\circ j_Z$. For each open $W\subseteq X$, choose an isomorphism $a_W:j_Z(i^{-1}W)\cong b_i(j_X(W))$ of etale $Z$-schemes whose first pullback projection is the restricted morphism $i|_W:i^{-1}W\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define the function $r_W:A(W)\to G(i^{-1}W)$ by $r_W(s)=e_Z^{-1}((i^*F)(a_W)(\eta^{\Et}_{j_X(W)}(e_X(s))))$, where $(i^*F)(a_W)$ denotes contravariant restriction along the hom of $a_W$. For any $z\in Z$, open neighbourhood $W$ of $i(z)$, open neighbourhood $V$ of $z$ contained in $i^{-1}W$, and sections $s,t\in A(W)$, if the restrictions of $r_W(s)$ and $r_W(t)$ to $V$ agree, then there exists an open neighbourhood $W_0\subseteq W$ of $i(z)$ such that $s|_{W_0}=t|_{W_0}$. Restriction maps are those of the stated presheaves.

proof.text: Transport the given equality by eZ.hom and naturality to equality of the two unit sections restricted along jZ(f) followed by a_W. Apply the pointed-witness lemma at the point (z,hzV) to obtain U, g and u with equal restrictions and U.hom(u)=i(z).

Let W0 be the range of U to X, open because that map is etale. It contains i(z) and lies in W by the commutativity of g over X. Lift U to W0 using the universal property of the open subscheme. This lift is surjective by the definition of W0. Its singleton family is a cover in X_et (the small etale covering criterion). The factorization to W is unique because W to X is mono. Separatedness of F on this cover therefore reflects equality to F(W0).
Naturality of eX identifies the resulting equality with equality of eX.hom applied to the restrictions in Fzar. The component of an isomorphism is injective, so the restrictions are equal.

theorem gabber_zariski_etale_local_agreement
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (Fzar : TopCat.Sheaf (Type (max (u + 1) v)) X.carrier)
    (eX : Fzar.obj ≅
      (MorphismProperty.Comma.lift (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤) (W := ⊤)
        X.restrictFunctor (fun U => (inferInstance : Etale U.ι)) (fun _ => trivial)
        (fun _ => trivial)).op ⋙ F.obj)
    (iFzar : TopCat.Sheaf (Type (max (u + 1) v)) Z.carrier)
    (eZ : iFzar.obj ≅
      (MorphismProperty.Comma.lift (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤) (W := ⊤)
        Z.restrictFunctor (fun U => (inferInstance : Etale U.ι)) (fun _ => trivial)
        (fun _ => trivial)).op ⋙
      ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
        (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).obj F).obj)
    (a : ∀ W : X.Opens, Scheme.Etale.mk (i ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≅
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι))
    (ha : ∀ W : X.Opens,
      (a W).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst W.ι i = i ∣_ W)
    (W : X.Opens) (z : Z.carrier) (hzW : i.base z ∈ W)
    (V : Z.Opens) (hzV : z ∈ V) (f : V ⟶ i ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (s t : Fzar.obj.obj (op W))
    (heq : iFzar.obj.map f.op
      (eZ.inv.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
            (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).obj F).obj.map (a W).hom.op
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
              (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app F).hom.app
                (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) (eX.hom.app (op W) s)))) =
      iFzar.obj.map f.op
      (eZ.inv.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
            (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).obj F).obj.map (a W).hom.op
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
              (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app F).hom.app
                (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) (eX.hom.app (op W) t))))) :
    ∃ (W0 : X.Opens) (_ : i.base z ∈ W0) (g : W0 ⟶ W),
      Fzar.obj.map g.op s = Fzar.obj.map g.op t
